name: scientific-figure-builder
description: Reproducible scientific-figure workflows backed by a local lifecycle MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Plan, render, validate, repair, and export publication-ready scientific figures through a governed lifecycle. Deterministic Python and SVG paths own data, text, equations, layout, and export; configured providers handle eligible image and multimodal work.
defaultPrompt: Create a publication-ready figure from my data.
Plan and validate a reproducible multipanel figure.
Export my scientific figure as PNG, SVG, and PDF.
